description: This file defines the DurableTaskCompletionSource class implementing a task completion source with persistence and state management, along with related interfaces, enums, and data structures for durable task handling within Orleans framework.

classes.name: DurableTaskCompletionSource
classes.description: A durable, persistent implementation of a task completion source that supports recovery, cancellation, and exception handling within Orleans.

methods.name: TrySetResult
methods.description: Attempts to set the result of the task if the current state is pending.

methods.name: TrySetException
methods.description: Attempts to set an exception for the task if the current state is pending.

methods.name: TrySetCanceled
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the task if the current state is pending.

methods.name: OnValuePersisted
methods.description: Completes the Task based on the current state when the value is persisted.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Deserializes and applies a log entry to restore the state of the completion source.

methods.name: WriteState
methods.description: Serializes the current state of the completion source to storage.
